commit.message:
feat(post): optionally end a Tormach program in the machine's native units

LinuxCNC's M2/M30 reset list (linuxcnc.org/docs, M-codes, "M2, M30
Program End") does not include G20/G21, so a mm program leaves an
inch-run PathPilot control in mm after M30. A new post option, "End in"
(Program's unit by default / Inch / mm), lives in PostOptions as
end_units. It is set through the undoable SetPostOptions, saved as
post_options.end_units (additive, no version step), and reaches the
script as postOptions.EndUnits. When the chosen unit differs from the
program's, tormach.cps writes G20 or G21 after the final G53 G0 Z0 / G30
and right before M30. Left at the default, the output is byte-identical.
The Post page shows the row while Tormach PathPilot is the post.

Fixes #596
